method: Every figure is measured like-for-like from nightly price snapshots of Bangladesh phone shops: official against official, import against import, one storage variant against the same variant, and a shop price comparison only across three or more distinct shops.

stories.headline: The same phone costs ==9.7% more== at Salextra than at the cheapest shop
stories.caption:
We took the same phone — same model, same storage, same channel — and checked what each shop wanted for it on the same night. 150 times.

Salextra came out 9.7% above the cheapest shop on average. GaziElectronics came out 0.6%.

• GaziElectronics — +0.6% (31 comparisons)
• RioInternational — +1.8% (88 comparisons)
• Dazzle — +2.1% (27 comparisons)
• SMSGadget — +2.9% (81 comparisons)
• AppleGadgets — +5.0% (72 comparisons)
• SumashTech — +6.7% (127 comparisons)
• GadgetAndGear — +8.2% (90 comparisons)
• Pickaboo — +9.2% (83 comparisons)
• Salextra — +9.7% (30 comparisons)

Nobody is being accused of anything: shops bundle differently and stock different things. But if you are about to spend six figures, the shop you walk into is worth knowing. Checked every night, every shop we track:
https://bhalophone.com

Which shop do you actually buy from?

stories.headline: Waiting 56 days on the OnePlus 13 saved you ==৳27,900==
stories.caption:
Somebody paid ৳103,899 for a OnePlus 13 back in 2026-07-04. It is ৳75,999 today.

৳27,900, for waiting 56 days. The four phones we have watched fall hardest since the first night anyone here quoted a price:

• OnePlus 13 — ৳103,899 to ৳75,999, −27% in 56 days (official price)
• Apple iPhone 16 Plus — ৳184,999 to ৳135,000, −27% in 79 days (official price)
• Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra — ৳245,999 to ৳179,999, −27% in 56 days (official price)
• Xiaomi 17 — ৳99,999 to ৳78,000, −22% in 56 days (unofficial price)

Every line is one channel against itself, so a sold-out listing never reads as a price cut. Night-by-night history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/oneplus-13

Anything you are holding out on? Name it and we will watch it.

stories.headline: Samsung's warranty on the Galaxy Z Fold 5 costs ==৳162,000==
stories.caption:
Official Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5, 12GB/256GB: ৳285,999.
The identical unofficial box: ৳123,999.

৳162,000 is what the warranty costs you on this phone. Both in stock today. The four widest gaps we can price on both channels right now:

• Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 12GB/256GB — official ৳285,999 vs unofficial ৳123,999 (৳162,000 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 12GB/256GB — official ৳224,999 vs unofficial ৳94,490 (৳130,509 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 6 12GB/256GB — official ৳197,999 vs unofficial ৳84,999 (৳113,000 apart)
• Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB — official ৳341,999 vs unofficial ৳239,999 (৳102,000 apart)

Same storage on both sides, always. Quoting the cheapest official against the cheapest unofficial usually compares 512GB with 256GB and doubles the gap. Specs, shops and the full history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/samsung-galaxy-s25-ultra

Official or unofficial — which way did you go, and would you do it again?

stories.headline: The Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold lost ==৳83,991== in 30 nights

• Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold — ৳229,990 to ৳145,999 (-36%, unofficial price)
• Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra — ৳245,999 to ৳179,999 (-27%, official price)

Official against official, unofficial against unofficial. When a cheap listing sells out and the headline price jumps to the official one, that is not a rise and it is not in this list. Night-by-night history:
